senses.sense_definition: Historical records, chronicles, or recorded history as a whole.

examples.text: His heroic deeds are preserved forever in the <w>annals</w> of our nation.
The discovery marked one of the most exciting breakthroughs in the <w>annals</w> of modern medicine.

senses.sense_definition: A historical record of events arranged strictly year by year in chronological order.

examples.text: Monks in medieval monasteries maintained detailed <w>annals</w> documenting plagues, battles, and royal successions.
Historians examined the ancient <w>annals</w> to verify the exact year of the earthquake.

senses.sense_definition: A periodic scholarly publication containing records of research discoveries, reports, or transactions of an academic society.

examples.text: Her groundbreaking study on marine ecosystems was recently accepted by the <w>annals</w> of the biological institute.
Researchers frequently consult the society's published <w>annals</w> to review peer-reviewed findings.
The manuscript was composed of separate <w>annals</w> that each covered a single calendar year.
Several brief monastic <w>annals</w> were compiled into one comprehensive historical volume.
